Its primary purpose is to provide a secure workspace where teams can assign role-based permissions, manage advertising campaigns, and schedule content across multiple accounts. Go to business.facebook.com and click "Create Account," entering your business name, your name, and a business email to register. Once verified, claim your Facebook Page and Instagram account by entering their URLs, then assign roles like Admin or Editor to team members under Business Settings. Ensure your personal Facebook profile is linked but keep administrative permissions controlled, and configure data sharing settings to manage who sees analytics and ad account details.

Facebook Business Manager is a centralized dashboard that lets you manage ad accounts, Facebook and Instagram Pages, product catalogs, and pixels in one place. It includes team management tools for assigning roles and permissions, ad creation and reporting features, and commerce tools like catalog management and checkout integration. For content creators, it’s useful for tracking analytics, running ads, and collaborating with team members or agencies while keeping brand assets organized.

Facebook Business Manager is a centralized dashboard for managing Pages, ad accounts, pixels, and team permissions, while a standard Facebook Page is the public-facing profile where you post content and interact with followers. It lets creators grant team members access to specific assets without sharing personal passwords and provides advanced tools for advertising, analytics, and inventory management. Enable two-factor authentication for all Business Manager accounts and assign role-based permissions so users only access the tools and data they need. Require dedicated business email addresses for team members, regularly audit active users and third-party app integrations, and monitor login alerts for suspicious activity. Never share login credentials and revoke access immediately when employees leave the organization.
